quests.title: The Crop Production Farm Simulator
quests.description: Become a master farmer and learn sustainable agriculture to feed the world!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Future Farm Academy! Farmer Greenthumb needs your help to revolutionize agriculture using scientific methods. Learn to grow crops sustainably while protecting the environment!

steps.title: Crop Variety Selection Challenge
steps.narrative: Your first farming decision: choose the right crop varieties for different conditions. Each choice affects your farm's success!

problem.question: Which crop variety would be best for an area with less rainfall?
problem.explanation: Smart farming choice! Drought-resistant varieties can survive with less water, making them perfect for dry areas. Sustainable farming matches crops to conditions!

steps.title: Fertilizer and Nutrient Laboratory
steps.narrative: Enter the Nutrient Lab where you learn to feed plants properly! Balance nutrients to grow healthy, strong crops.

problem.question: What are the three main nutrients that plants need from fertilizers?
problem.explanation: Nutrient mastery! NPK (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium) are the big three! Nitrogen for green growth, phosphorus for roots, potassium for overall health!

steps.title: Irrigation Water Management Mission
steps.narrative: Water is precious! Learn different irrigation methods to give crops the right amount of water without waste.

problem.question: Which irrigation method saves the most water?
problem.explanation: Water conservation champion! Drip irrigation delivers water directly to plant roots drop by drop, saving up to 50% more water than other methods!

steps.title: Become the Sustainable Farming Master
steps.narrative: The ultimate farming challenge! Create a complete sustainable farming plan that feeds people while protecting the environment!

problem.question: What is the most important principle of sustainable farming?
options: Grow only one type of crop
problem.explanation: Sustainable Farming Master achieved! True farming success means growing enough food while keeping soil healthy, water clean, and biodiversity thriving!

quests.title: The Microorganism Detective Laboratory
quests.description: Explore the invisible world of microorganisms and discover their amazing powers!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Microorganism Detective Lab! Dr. Micro needs your help to investigate the invisible world of bacteria, viruses, and fungi that affect our daily lives!

steps.title: Beneficial Microbe Mission
steps.narrative: Not all microorganisms are harmful! Discover the helpful microbes that make our lives better in amazing ways.

problem.question: Which beneficial microorganism helps make yogurt?
problem.explanation: Excellent microbial knowledge! Lactobacillus bacteria ferment milk to make delicious, healthy yogurt. These friendly microbes also help our digestion!

steps.title: Harmful Microbe Defense System
steps.narrative: Learn to protect yourself and others from harmful microorganisms! Develop defense strategies against disease-causing microbes.

problem.question: What is the best way to prevent the spread of harmful bacteria?
problem.explanation: Perfect defense strategy! Hand washing with soap is the most effective way to remove harmful microbes and prevent disease spread!

steps.title: Food Preservation Laboratory
steps.narrative: Discover how to keep food safe from harmful microorganisms! Learn preservation methods that have fed humanity for centuries.

problem.question: Why does adding salt help preserve food?
options: Salt removes water that microbes need
problem.correct_answer: Salt removes water that microbes need
problem.explanation: Food preservation genius! Salt draws out water from food and microbes. Without water, harmful bacteria can't survive and multiply!

steps.title: Challenge the Microbe Master
steps.narrative: The ultimate microbiology test! The Microbe Master challenges you to solve a complex case involving both helpful and harmful microorganisms!

problem.question: A bread-making factory wants to use microorganisms. Which would be most helpful?
problem.explanation: Microbe Master defeated! Yeast ferments sugars in dough, producing carbon dioxide that makes bread rise and taste delicious!

quests.title: The Synthetic Materials Factory
quests.description: Explore the amazing world of synthetic fibers and plastics in the futuristic materials factory!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Synthetic Materials Factory of the future! Engineer Polymer needs your help to understand how synthetic materials are made and their impact on our world!

steps.title: Fiber Classification Center
steps.narrative: Learn to distinguish between natural and synthetic fibers! Each type has special properties for different uses.

problem.question: Which of these is a synthetic fiber?
problem.explanation: Perfect classification! Nylon is synthetic (human-made), while cotton, wool, and silk come from plants or animals (natural fibers)!

steps.title: Plastic Properties Workshop
steps.narrative: Discover why plastics are so useful! Learn about their amazing properties that make modern life possible.

problem.question: What makes plastic useful for making water bottles?
problem.explanation: Material science mastery! Plastic is waterproof (doesn't absorb water) and lightweight, making it perfect for portable water bottles!

steps.title: Environmental Impact Assessment
steps.narrative: Engineer Polymer shows you the environmental challenges of synthetic materials. Learn about responsible use and recycling!

problem.question: What is the main environmental problem with plastic waste?
problem.explanation: Environmental awareness achieved! Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose, so we must reduce, reuse, and recycle to protect our planet!

steps.title: Become a Sustainable Materials Innovator
steps.narrative: The ultimate materials challenge! Design eco-friendly alternatives to harmful synthetic materials and save the environment!

problem.question: What would be the best eco-friendly alternative to plastic bags?
options: Cloth bags that can be reused
problem.correct_answer: Cloth bags that can be reused
problem.explanation: Innovation champion! Reusable cloth bags reduce waste, last longer, and protect the environment. You're a true sustainable materials innovator!
